title: Annular variation of the triangular Hilbert transform at the symmetric point
summary: We prove the annular r -variation estimate for the triangular Hilbert transform from complex $`L^3\times L^3`$ to L 3/2 for every r > 2. The partitions may depend on the output point and range over all positive scales. The estimate yields the two-endpoint maximal bound and joint almost-everywhere and norm principal values, and resolves the symmetric scalar triangular Hilbert transform problem.
family_title: Annular variation and dyadic absolute bounds for the triangular Hilbert transform
